scoring_justification: Agent artifact is the three crystal-field parameters (Dq, B, splitting). Recompute from raw artifact infeasible because the artifact only contains the final numbers; no richer intermediate available. Checker compares agent's reported values to paper-reported gold with generous tolerances, using exact_match policy with partial credit decay.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported crystal-field parameters used as hidden reference for scoring
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: Dq=413 cm⁻¹, B=455 cm⁻¹, low-symmetry splitting of ⁴T₂(⁴F) level ~200 cm⁻¹ (explicit statements in paper body and Fig.1 discussion).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from paper's stated values; Dq and B are given numerically; splitting is given as '~200 cm⁻¹'.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the actual paper-reported quantities for the same task; traceable to paper text.

outputs.description: Crystal‑field strength Dq, Racah parameter B, and the low‑symmetry splitting of the ⁴T₂(⁴F) level, all in cm⁻¹. The hidden checker compares these values to the paper‑reported reference with generous tolerances for implementation differences.

output_contract.notes: The six peak positions used as input are stated directly in the agent's instruction and do not require parsing the paper. The solver is expected to implement standard crystal‑field theory for d⁷ in tetrahedral symmetry using Tanabe–Sugano relations.

steps.description: Validate fit_params.json contains Dq, B, splitting. Score each against paper gold with generous tolerances; partial credit proportional to error beyond tolerance.
